title: fedrequests
description: Records stored at (askedHolonId, 'fedrequests', <askingHolonId>). A partner's request that the asked holon match (kind 'link') or drop (kind 'unlink') its half of a federation link. Counts only when signed by an admin of the asking or the asked holon (newest such record wins); see @holons/core/federation requests.ts.

to.description: The asked holon (the holon the record is stored in).

kind.description: 'link': adopt the directions below; 'unlink': drop the half that names `from`.

inbound.description: Lenses the asked holon is asked to RECEIVE from `from`. Sorted, deduped.

outbound.description: Lenses the asked holon is asked to SEND to `from`. Both may be empty: a link with no flows yet.

hops.description: Scalespace reach, carried as-is when `from` is an H3 cell.

fromName.description: The asking holon's display name, as the asker knew it.

proposedAt.description: Unix seconds of the proposal this record is about.

at.description: Unix seconds of the last change.

messageId.description: Where a surface announced it (a Telegram message id), written by an admin of the asked holon.

by.description: Who settled it, in the surface's own terms (e.g. a Telegram user id).
